spans.s: फणिपति, i. e. फणिन्-, m. the king of the serpents,

फण्, i. 1, Par. To go.
 --Caus. फणय,
 1. To cause to go.
 2. To produce easily (cf. फाण्ट).
फण, m., and f. णा, The expanded hood or neck of the cobra di capello, or snake in general, Pañc. i. d. 107; Śāk. d. 158;
फण-भृ + त्, फणवन्त् फण + वन्त्, and फणिन् फणिन्, i. e. फण + इन्, m. A snake,

फाण्ट, i. e. फण्, Caus., + त,
 I. ptcple. of the pf. pass. of the causal of फण्, Readily or easily prepared.
 II. m. Diluted decoction
 III. n. The [] first particle of butter that are prepared by churning.
फणि(न्)- + मुख फणि(न्)- + मुख, a kind of spade, Daśak. in
+ रुच् फणा-मणि-सहस्र- + रुच्, f. the splendour of the thousand jewels of the serpent's hoods, Śiś. 9, 25.
